T: Walk, don't run, to the buffet.
D: A young woman in Detroit is followed by something that only ever walks towards her.
P: Serve the snacks when the gang heads to the public pool for the last stand.
S: Cocktail franks topped with spiced beef chilli

Cocktail franks simmered 5 minutes, tucked into split mini rolls, topped with a spoon of beef chilli simmered with cumin and paprika, a stripe of yellow mustard and finely diced raw onion. Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, add 150ml water and simmer 20 minutes. Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Tuck into split mini rolls, spoon over chilli, add mustard and diced onion.
Slow cooked onions folded into sour cream and cream cheese dip

Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives, served with thick ridged potato chips. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes until jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.
the Detroit suburbs the film lives in

Thick, airy pan pizza with crunchy caramelised cheese edges, cupped pepperoni and stripes of chunky tomato sauce on top, cut into small squares. Press 500g pizza dough into an oiled 23 x 33cm tin and prove 1 hour. Push the dough to the corners, cover with 80g sliced pepperoni, then 300g cubed mozzarella right to the edges so it touches the tin. Bake at 250C for 14 minutes until the edges are dark and crisp. Simmer 300g crushed tomatoes with garlic, oregano and a pinch of sugar for 15 minutes and spoon over in two stripes. Cut into 16 squares.
M: the trip out to the lake to get away from it

Crisp beer-battered flathead in warm corn tortillas with lime slaw, pickled onion, avocado crema and a hit of hot sauce. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with salt for 20 minutes. Shred a quarter red cabbage and toss with lime juice and coriander. Blitz 1 avocado with 100g sour cream and lime. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold beer and salt. Cut 600g flathead into strips, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, crema and hot sauce.
Marinated pork shoulder in warm pitas with tzatziki, tomato and red onion
Pork marinated with garlic, oregano and lemon, griddled and sliced, wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion and chips.
W: Chocolate cookies sandwiching vanilla ice cream, edges rolled in mini choc chips
Soft chocolate cookies baked at 175C for 9 minutes, cooled, sandwiched with a thick slice of vanilla ice cream, rolled in mini choc chips and frozen an hour before serving.
K: Fresh lemonade with sliced lemon and plenty of ice, no alcohol

Lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water in a big jug, sliced lemon and plenty of ice. Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add sliced lemon and plenty of ice and pour into four glasses.

s.note: Cocktail franks topped with spiced beef chilli
s.how: Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, add 150ml water and simmer 20 minutes. Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Tuck into split mini rolls, spoon over chilli, add mustard and diced onion.

m.note: Marinated pork shoulder in warm pitas with tzatziki, tomato and red onion
m.how: Marinate 700g pork shoulder steaks in 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano, juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil for 2 hours. Griddle 4 minutes a side and slice thin. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with half a grated cucumber and garlic for tzatziki. Wrap the pork in 4 warm pitas with tzatziki, sliced tomato and red onion.

w.note: Chocolate cookies sandwiching vanilla ice cream, edges rolled in mini choc chips
w.how: Beat 100g butter and 150g brown sugar with 1 egg, then mix in 150g flour and 30g cocoa. Scoop 8 cookies and bake at 175C for 9 minutes. Cool, sandwich with thick slices of vanilla ice cream, roll the edges in mini choc chips and freeze an hour.
